card.name: Period ending a preparation step
card.fires_on: The full stop that ends a sentence in drug preparation or reconstitution instructions, after steps like stirring, mixing, dissolving or diluting. The next sentence usually starts a new step or a timing note.

modes.label: End of mixing step
modes.description: Period after an instruction to stir, dissolve, crush or suspend a product in liquid.
